id.description: id for the input. Label and hint ids are derived from this.

name.description: name attribute for the input. Defaults to id.

hint.description: Hint text displayed below the label.

fileListHint.description: Heading/hint text shown above the managed file list, passed to FileList's hint prop. React only.

error.description: Error message. Renders aria-describedby and error styling.

accept.description: Comma-separated list of accepted file types/extensions, e.g. ".pdf,.txt".

multiple.description: Allows selecting more than one file.

manageIndividualFiles.description: When multiple is true, selects files one at a time into a managed list where each file has its own Delete action (VA.gov file-input-multiple pattern). React only.

invalidFileTypeMessage.description: Custom error message shown when a selected file doesn't match `accept`. Sets data-errormessage.

defaultFiles.description: When manageIndividualFiles is true, seeds the managed file list with files that already exist on the server (no browser File object). Each entry is { name, size?, url? } — omit size to show no size, provide url to render the name as a download link. React only.
